system.name: Discount Model Search (DMS)
system.one_liner: A quality diversity algorithm that replaces CMA-MAE's histogram discount function with a smooth learned model so exploration continues in high-dimensional measure spaces.

content.variant_note: two matched schematic plots, the failing histogram discount and the smooth model, then a measured line chart that shows the failure in practice
content.argues: A histogram discount function gives solutions in the same cell identical improvement values and stalls search; a smooth discount model gives distinct values (Δ2 > Δ1) and keeps guiding exploration.
content.subject: A flat objective, three archive cells on a measure axis, two solutions and their improvement gaps under a step versus a smooth discount function, plus a unique-cells curve.

summary: Quality diversity optimization looks for solutions that are good and diverse under a vector-valued measure. CMA-MAE guides exploration with a histogram discount function over measure space, which stagnates in high-dimensional measure spaces because similar solutions share a cell. Figure 1 explains this in three panels. Panels (a) and (b) are matched schematics: a flat objective f as a dashed line, three archive cells on the measure axis m(θ), two solutions θ1 and θ2 as dots and orange Δ arrows for archive improvement. With the blue step function of CMA-MAE the two arrows are equal; with the smooth blue curve of Discount Model Search they differ, Δ2 > Δ1. Panel (c) is a line chart of unique cells over iterations in 2D and 10D LP (Sphere). Plain serif, flat vector, white ground.
summary_zh: 质量多样性优化中，CMA-MAE用直方图折扣函数，高维度量空间里相似解落入同一格而停滞。图(a)(b)用同样的版面：阶梯曲线下两解增益Δ相等，DMS的平滑模型下Δ2大于Δ1；(c)是2D/10D基准中独特格数随迭代下降的折线图。
notes: Prior kinds kept but reordered: the matched (a)/(b) pair makes side-by-side-contrast primary. Blue and orange are the seaborn colour-blind palette and are reused in (c) with different meanings. In (c) a single marker per series sits on its line (circle near the start, diamond near 3000 iterations), matching the legend samples.
